question:
In modern enterprises, the management and evaluation of technology solutions is an important part of ensuring that technology investment generates maximum value and promotes business innovation. With the rapid development of information technology, various technology solutions (such as software tools, hardware equipment, cloud services, artificial intelligence systems, etc.) have become key means for enterprises to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and optimize products and services. However, how to effectively manage and evaluate these technology solutions to ensure that they meet business needs and achieve expected results has become a challenge for enterprises.
Therefore, enterprises need a dedicated technology solution management and evaluation system. Management of technology solutions: record and track the selection, implementation and maintenance process of various technology solutions to ensure that they can continue to meet the technology needs of the enterprise.
Evaluation of solutions: evaluate the effectiveness of various technology solutions, evaluate their cost-effectiveness, implementation progress, user feedback, etc.

-- Schema for database: rschema_0098

CREATE TABLE `technology_category` (
  `category_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `category_description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `parent_category_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`category_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `technology_category_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_category_id`) REFERENCES `technology_category` (`category_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `vendor` (
  `vendor_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `vendor_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `contact_person` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `contact_email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `contact_phone` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `website` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `country` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`vendor_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `technology_solution` (
  `solution_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `solution_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `solution_type` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. software, hardware, cloud service, AI system',
  `category_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `vendor_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `version` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. under_evaluation, active, deprecated, retired',
  `license_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `license_expiry_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `acquisition_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `total_cost` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`solution_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `technology_solution_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `technology_category` (`category_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `technology_solution_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`vendor_id`) REFERENCES `vendor` (`vendor_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `department` (
  `department_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `department_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `department_code` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `manager_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`department_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `employee` (
  `employee_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `full_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `department_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `job_title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`employee_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `employee_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`department_id`) REFERENCES `department` (`department_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `implementation_project` (
  `project_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `solution_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `project_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `department_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `project_manager_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `planned_start_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `actual_start_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `planned_end_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `actual_end_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. planned, in_progress, completed, on_hold, cancelled',
  `budget` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `actual_cost` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `progress_percentage` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `implementation_project_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`solution_id`) REFERENCES `technology_solution` (`solution_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `implementation_project_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`department_id`) REFERENCES `department` (`department_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `implementation_project_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`project_manager_id`) REFERENCES `employee` (`employee_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `project_milestone` (
  `milestone_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `milestone_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `planned_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `actual_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. pending, completed, delayed',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`milestone_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_milestone_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `implementation_project` (`project_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `maintenance_record` (
  `maintenance_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `solution_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `maintenance_type` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. upgrade, patch, repair, routine_check',
  `performed_by_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `maintenance_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `cost` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `outcome` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `next_maintenance_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`maintenance_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `maintenance_record_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`solution_id`) REFERENCES `technology_solution` (`solution_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `maintenance_record_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`performed_by_id`) REFERENCES `employee` (`employee_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `evaluation` (
  `evaluation_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `solution_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `evaluator_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `evaluation_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `evaluation_period_start` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `evaluation_period_end` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `overall_score` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Overall effectiveness score out of 100',
  `cost_effectiveness_score` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `implementation_progress_score` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `business_alignment_score` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `technical_performance_score` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `roi_percentage` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `summary` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `recommendation` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. continue, upgrade, replace, discontinue',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`evaluation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `evaluation_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`solution_id`) REFERENCES `technology_solution` (`solution_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `evaluation_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`evaluator_id`) REFERENCES `employee` (`employee_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user_feedback` (
  `feedback_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `solution_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `employee_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `feedback_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `usability_rating` int(11) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Rating 1-5',
  `performance_rating` int(11) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Rating 1-5',
  `support_rating` int(11) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Rating 1-5',
  `overall_satisfaction` int(11) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Rating 1-5',
  `comments` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `issues_reported` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `suggestions` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`feedback_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_feedback_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`solution_id`) REFERENCES `technology_solution` (`solution_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `user_feedback_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employee` (`employee_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `cost_record` (
  `cost_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `solution_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `cost_type` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. acquisition, subscription, maintenance, training, support',
  `amount` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL,
  `currency` char(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  `cost_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `recorded_by_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`cost_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `cost_record_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`solution_id`) REFERENCES `technology_solution` (`solution_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `cost_record_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`recorded_by_id`) REFERENCES `employee` (`employee_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `solution_requirement` (
  `requirement_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `solution_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `department_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `requirement_title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `requirement_description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `priority` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. high, medium, low',
  `status` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. met, partially_met, not_met',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`requirement_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `solution_requirement_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`solution_id`) REFERENCES `technology_solution` (`solution_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `solution_requirement_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`department_id`) REFERENCES `department` (`department_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
